name: Wire Machine Systems
old_description: Wire Machine Systems (WMS) was founded in 1987 in Fort Wayne, IN. Since its start, WMS has become a premier source of equipment and services to the wire, cable, bar, and tube industries, offering a “one-stop shop” solution to meet all of your needs. Wire Machine Systems’ facility is centrally located to operate on a national and international level as a trusted supplier of machinery, equipment, and spare parts.
about:
Wire Machine Systems was founded in 1987 in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The company began as a supplier of equipment and services to the wire, cable, bar, and tube industries, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for machinery and spare parts.

The company provides state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment for wire and cable drawing, insulation, handling, and surface treatment, as well as drawbenches, peeling and straightening systems, measuring instruments, buncher bows, spring coiling machines, and shot blasting systems for bars and tubes. It also maintains a centralized spare parts warehouse in Fort Wayne stocking replacement components for European and Asian machinery, and offers dedicated technical support to help customers source the exact part or machine they need.

Wire Machine Systems serves manufacturers in the wire, cable, bar, and tube sectors, including automotive, appliance, and industrial spring producers that require high-precision coiling and tight-tolerance processing. Its customer base spans national and international operations across these industries.

The company emphasizes its one-stop-shop model, combining equipment sales, spare parts availability, and technical support under one roof. It highlights over 50 years of combined industry experience, a centralized warehouse for rapid delivery, and the ability to supply replacement parts for equipment it did not originally sell, aiming to minimize downtime for its clients.
